source.author: Claudius Ptolemy
source.title: Tetrabiblos
source.chapter: Book III section 13 Of the Quality of the Soul
source.edition: F. E. Robbins, Loeb Classical Library English translation (1940)

rules.historical_conditionality: Dignity, rulership, sect and angle conditions may reverse the description; mere pairwise aspect is not evidence of sole or joint soul dominion.

source_limitations: The source supplies contradictory and historically conditioned character lists; it cannot be directly converted into precise modern personality probabilities.
Do not infer governor of soul from simple square/trine or dignified planet alone.
Do not treat 13 source records as 13 independent pieces of predictive information.
A source record concerning astronomy or soul disorders is not a modern psychiatric diagnosis.
No claim of full original Greek collation.
